evals.name: handoff-unmatched-values
evals.prompt: מיפינו את דוח הבנק המצורף (bank_report.docx) לתבנית Quicker, ובסוף נשארו כמה ערכים בלי משתנה - הם מופיעים ב-template_plan.json תחת unmatched. תוסיף לטופס של המשרד ('שומת מקרקעין - משרד בדיקה') את מה שצריך כדי שגם הם יתמלאו מ-Quicker.
evals.expected_output: A plan on the office form (not the system form) adding kitchen floor type and size next to the other finish fields, with the sibling options and AI Fill prompts; the signer's title and the standard-9 wording stay fixed text; conditions flagged by the template's decisions fixed and labelled; apply-off said before the approval question.
assertions: the plan came back pending with no rejected operation
the final message does not claim the form was changed
the final message says apply is not enabled and how to proceed
adds a kitchen floor type field
adds a kitchen floor size field
kitchen fields go to propertyFields next to the other finish fields
kitchen floor type reuses the sibling options
every new field has an AI Fill prompt
the signer's title and the standard-9 wording don't become fields
the plan summary is shown verbatim

evals.name: standard19-gap
evals.prompt: אנחנו מתחילים לעשות שומות לבטוחה לאשראי לבנק עסקי, לפי תקן 19, על הטופס של המשרד ('שומת מקרקעין - משרד בדיקה'). עוד אין לנו דוח מוכן לסוג הזה. מה חסר לנו בטופס כדי לעמוד בתקן? תכין את השינויים לטופס.
evals.expected_output: A standard-19 gap report with sources (missing / partial / present), a plan of additions behind one switch so the office's mortgage projects don't change, judgement fields told not to be filled by AI Fill, and findings for default texts and org lists that ops can't change.
assertions: the plan came back pending with no rejected operation
the final message does not claim the form was changed
the final message says apply is not enabled and how to proceed
adds a collateral value field (ערך למטרת בטוחה)
adds realisation taxes (מס שבח and היטל השבחה)
adds soil contamination
adds non-conforming uses
every new field has an AI Fill prompt
cites standard 19 sections in the message
type-specific fields are shown only when relevant (condition on every new field added to a section)
restraint: at most 35 operations
the plan summary is shown verbatim

evals.name: small-option-change
evals.prompt: תוסיף בטופס של המשרד לגורם המפנה את 'בנק ירושלים', ולסוג ההלוואה את 'משכנתא הפוכה'.
evals.expected_output: One add_options op on loanType; no op on referrer (an organization list) - the user is sent to the settings for בנק ירושלים and told which bank-specific fields a new referrer doesn't get.
assertions: the plan came back pending with no rejected operation
the final message does not claim the form was changed
the final message says apply is not enabled and how to proceed
plans add_options 'משכנתא הפוכה' on loanType
no op on referrer (organization list)
tells the user בנק ירושלים is added in the settings option lists

evals.name: env-checks
evals.prompt: תוסיף לטופס של המשרד ('שומת מקרקעין - משרד בדיקה') את הבדיקות שאנחנו כותבים בכל דוח: אתר עתיקות (כולל צילום ממפת רשות העתיקות), מבנה מסוכן, חריגות בנייה, תוואי רכבת קלה בקרבת הנכס, אנטנות סלולריות בסביבה (צילום מ-GovMap), ותיאור מפורט של הסביבה והתשתיות.
evals.expected_output: Each check is a question with a 'לא נבדק' answer; its details (description, screenshot, distance, order date) open only on the answer that reports a finding - the antiquities map only when the property is in a site; no != conditions; existing free-text fields reused with a transition condition; long text as richtext with an HTML prompt; question prompts say silence is not 'no'.
assertions: the plan came back pending with no rejected operation
the final message says apply is not enabled before asking
no display-logic mistake on the fields the plan adds or changes (audit: ungated, negated, dead value, chain)
no negated (!=) condition on a new or changed field
every question about an outside check offers 'לא נבדק'
detailed text is added as richtext, not textarea
richtext prompts ask AI Fill for HTML paragraphs
question prompts don't let AI Fill answer 'no' from silence
all six requested checks exist in the form after the plan
the antiquities map is hidden when the answer is 'לא נבדק'
the antiquities map is hidden when the property is not in a site
the plan summary is shown verbatim
